title: All Languages Matter: On the Multilingual Safety of LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured 'Unfairness', defined as social bias based on race, gender, religion, and appearance, as one of 14 safety issues.
base_benchmarks: Safety assessment of chinese large language models (Sun et al., 2023)
findings: The paper does not provide findings specific to religion. However, for the broader 'Unfairness' category, which includes religion-based bias, it found that all tested LLMs generated significantly more unsafe responses for non-English queries compared to English queries. The 'Unfairness' category in general showed lower unsafe ratios compared to other categories like 'Commonsense Safety' or 'Goal Hijacking'.
